spec: Production createBattle accepts a detached, validated authored map without registry mutation, records exact initial terrain for replay, and deploys every initial roster unit without overlap.
expect: Published 20x10 and 40x40 maps run through direct input; unknown IDs support human commands, simulation, JSON replay and reload. Invalid metadata, unknown fields, identity conflicts and overlap reject or deploy safely. Existing20 control hashes remain exact.
note: No atlas conversion, props, LOS, viewer adoption or V1 fallback. Direct map.loaded carries exact terrain; absent map preserves historical events. Mixed deployment reserves explicit positions and actual rolled heroes without changing collision-free candidate lists.
